key_insight: Multi-Head Low-Rank Attention compresses per-head KV caches via low-rank factorization and a shard-friendly layout, removing the Tensor Parallelism sharding bottleneck and cutting repeated HBM→SRAM transfers during autoregressive decoding.
problem_solved: Addresses the KV cache loading bottleneck for long-context LLM decoding — repeated off-chip HBM→SRAM transfers and TP sharding inefficiencies that limit throughput, latency, and usable context length.
method: Per-head low-rank factorization of Key and Value tensors to store compact factor matrices instead of full KV caches.
On-chip reconstruction and attention computation from low-rank factors to minimize per-step data movement and bandwidth use.
Shard-aware cache layout and communication pattern compatible with Tensor Parallelism to eliminate cross-shard synchronization bottlenecks.
impact: Reduces memory bandwidth, latency, and energy for long-context inference, enabling larger effective context windows and more efficient distributed decoding on existing hardware.
